script_text: Saturn squares your natal Moon from Pisces, Taurus, forcing a deep emotional reckoning logic alone cannot quiet. Mercury in Leo streams into your 11th House through Wednesday, bringing unexpected messages about your circle. Mars drains energy in your 12th House, so conserve force early. Thursday shifts everything when Venus enters your 5th House, flooding romance and creative sparks through your Earth element world. Jupiter trines your natal Sun from Cancer, activating your 10th House with sudden career momentum. Sun-Uranus opposition then rocks your 7th House of partnerships this weekend, demanding honest conversation. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, unlocking love and creative abundance. Sunday is your worst day as Saturn squares your Moon, amplifying emotional heaviness in personal bonds. Dedicate one evening to a solo creative project — Venus and Saturn are building something permanent there. Follow for daily updates.
